title: 1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception) Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception).

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: How are logotypes treated?
elements.feedback: The criterion notes that logotypes are considered essential.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Does alt text alone satisfy the restriction on images of text?
elements.feedback: The restriction still applies even when an alternative is supplied.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What can replace promotional text embedded in a banner?
choices: A larger image of the same text
elements.feedback: Real text can adapt to user settings.
